title: Nested affine opens: the inclusion is Spec of the restriction map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq U'$ affine opens of $X$, with $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $R'=\mathcal O_X(U')$ and $\rho:R'\to R$ the restriction map; let $\iota_U:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ and $\iota_{U'}:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to X$ be the canonical open immersions with images $U$, $U'$ of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. Then $\iota_{U'}\circ\operatorname{Spec}\rho=\iota_U$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $\operatorname{Spec}\rho:\operatorname{Spec}R\to\operatorname{Spec}R'$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion].

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01LN (lemma-spec-inclusion), the bottom arrow $U\to U'$ of its square, read through Schemes, Lemma 01I2 (lemma-category-affine-schemes: morphisms of affine schemes are Spec of ring maps)

mathlib_searches.query: for affine opens V ≤ U, Spec of the restriction map composed with the open immersion Spec Γ(U) → X equals Spec Γ(V) → X
